tagline: Review for an MCP gateway that runs other coding agents: task start, apply, discard and code sent to agent providers.
summary: AgentHub is one MCP gateway from Claude Code or any MCP client to local coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, Aider and Goose. This opt-in coverage reviews the tools that run an agent or change its work: ask, start_task, send_message, review, compare, apply_task, cancel_task and discard_task, plus any tool it does not list. Read-only task and session tools (list_agents, get_task, wait_task, get_task_logs, list_tasks, get_task_diff, list_sessions, search_sessions, get_transcript, list_models) follow normal Guard policy.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the reviewed AgentHub MCP tools and the surrounding Guard policy.
Matching applies to the agenthub-gateway package launched through uvx; other launchers fall back to normal Guard policy.
Permission modes, trusted workspaces and worktree isolation are enforced by AgentHub, not by Guard.
A publisher profile or badge is not a security certification or an endorsement by HOL.
